enemy-048-cult-host.designLock: One original Tantalus human colonist cult adherent derived only from Aliens: Dark Descent's Lethe cult/medical-horror context: gaunt but recognizably human adult, visible feverish human face, worn gray-beige-brown colony work clothes, restrained dried blood, and a limited salvaged medical containment harness around abdomen and lower chest with matte braces, straps, tubing and injectors. The person remains human and voluntary/feverish in posture; no full xenomorph transformation. This is not the Guardian, not an exact Embryostatis copy, and not a canonical class named Cult Host. Strict right-facing orthographic profile. Future bitmap art must be original and may not trace any official game frame or model.

referenceLock.silhouette: Gaunt but fully human colonist in worn workwear, feverish voluntary posture, visible human head and limited abdomen/chest medical harness.
referenceLock.palette: Gray, beige and brown colony textiles, unhealthy skin, restrained dried blood, matte dull medical metal; no fantasy color coding.
referenceLock.apparatus: Simplified original containment harness with straps, modest braces, short tubing and injectors; not an exact Guardian/Embryostatis copy.
referenceLock.anatomy: Two human arms, two human legs, human skull and face, no tail, inner jaw, carapace or exposed permanent chestburster.
referenceLock.facing: Strict right-facing orthographic side view across 32 poses.
